feedback.comments: Amazing Dal Makhani and Rajasthan Thali! Loved the authentic royal heritage feel.
Excellent service by Rahul. Food was fresh and served hot.
Great Jain options available. Very cooperative staff.
Best Butter Chicken in Jaipur! Tandoori roti was crisp.
Nice rooftop atmosphere with pleasant live instrumental music.
Food was good but order took slightly longer than 30 mins.
Rajasthan Thali is a must try! Very fulfilling.
Celebrated birthday in Private Dining. Wonderful arrangement.
Paneer tikka was extremely tender and fresh.
